searchText: how many dapps have been active/testing/being a part of the 7702 spec and discussions? 7702 isn't really a change that dapps need to engage with. we've had a fair number of wallets active during the spec discussions there is an old note about 7702 enabling universal cross chain deployments that is no longer valid. i've opened a PR to remove it however, without any solution for cross chain deployments, it feels like chain-agnostic 7702 signatures (chainId = 0) are not really able to fulfil their purpose? i'd love to hear people's thoughts on this... https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/8909 i feel like chain agnostic sigs are still useful for deploying a smart contract wallet everywhere? even on chains that don't yet exist there is no strong guarantee that the code pointer will be valid on new chains afaik that's fair there is a potential change to 7702 that would make it good for cross chain deployments that was proposed at one point. i just added it to the PR description as an alternative. not sure if there are any significant issues with it
